solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Vector Search
solution_components.role: Indexes and retrieves vector embeddings for semantic search and generative-AI workflows.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Search
solution_components.role: Provides integrated full-text and faceted search across Retail AI Solution's application data.

solution_components.name: Voyage AI
solution_components.role: Provides semantic embedding capabilities for retrieval and AI evaluation workloads.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the operational data and provides the managed document database foundation for Retail AI Solution's workload.

data_flow: Documents, logs, or product records are stored in MongoDB Atlas Vector Search, embedded or indexed for MongoDB Atlas Vector Search, and queried by Retail AI Solution's application workflows to return relevant results in real time.
business_outcome: With one platform replacing three, the company handles peak retail events at scale while streamlining operations.
metrics: The migration took two and a half months, supporting 180 million monthly active users with effectively zero downtime.
architecture_clues: Migration or scaling was completed with zero downtime.
